calls.statement:
SELECT
  f.vat_rate,
  ROUND(SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount), 2) AS vat_charged
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
  AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
GROUP BY f.vat_rate
ORDER BY f.vat_rate

-- Check for data issues and verify the VAT calculation
SELECT
  'Total VAT by rate' AS check_type,
  COUNT(*) AS line_count,
  SUM(gross_amount) AS total_gross,
  SUM(net_amount) AS total_net,
  ROUND(SUM(gross_amount - net_amount), 2) AS total_vat
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
  AND f.channel_code = 'ST'

calls.statement:
-- Check products with 25.5% VAT rate
SELECT DISTINCT
  p.vat_class,
  f.vat_rate,
  COUNT(*) AS line_count
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
  AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
GROUP BY p.vat_class, f.vat_rate
ORDER BY f.vat_rate
